title: Not what I expected
text:
Not what I expected. Between school lunches and baking, I have a ton of boxes that need organizing. For this reason, I was excited to receive this, but I was quickly disappointed upon using it.
It’s not very sturdy and does not hold the boxes in place. It is a nice idea/concept but needs some adjusting

product_metadata.title: YouCopia Adjustable WrapStand, Black
features: Organize kitchen wrap, aluminum foil, parchment paper and plastic food bags in a lower cabinet or pantry
Features 8 adjustable wires to fit an array of different box shapes and sizes - including "family size" baggies!
Use as a plastic food bag dispenser and transport caddy to work area; no mounting or Installation required
Reduce cabinet or pantry clutter and maximize vertical space; measures 5-1/2-inches long by 7-1/4-inches wide by 11-1/2-inches high
Made from durable ABS plastic and Coated steel wires; wipes clean with a damp cloth; imported; white
description: Wrap stand helps organize aluminum foil, plastic wrap, wax and parchment paper in the kitchen cabinet or pantry. This unique organizer includes eight adjustable wire holders that can be positioned to perfectly fit boxes. Remove one wrap at a time or carry the entire caddy to a work surface. It also makes a great food bag dispenser! vertical storage helps reduce clutter and maximize space. No mounting or installation is required.
